$schema_note: Interactive (non-sidebar) widgets used on pages 3-5. Sidebar/input-form widgets are defined separately in sidebar.json.

widgets.label: Zoom to phase
widgets.behavior: Filters/zooms all 5 subplots on Page 3 to the selected segment's start/end timestamps, using mission.SegmentResult boundaries.

widgets.label: Show generation N
widgets.behavior: Replays result.history[N].opt.get('F') from pymoo's saved optimization history (already captured via save_history=True in run_optimization()) -- no recomputation needed, just re-plotting a stored generation's population.

widgets.label: Click a Pareto-front point to inspect that design
widgets.behavior: On click, extracts that point's (battery_kwh, engine_kw, motor_kw) design variables and re-feeds them into mission.build_mission_profile(), then re-renders Page 3's five subplots for that specific design. Classic 'linked views' cross-page interaction.

widgets.label: Compare controllers
widgets.behavior: Controls which of the three strategies' power-split plots and bar-chart entries are shown.

widgets.label: Generate PDF Report
widgets.behavior: Triggers reporting/report_writer.py: fills a Jinja2 HTML template with the current session's computed values and plots, then converts to PDF via WeasyPrint.
widgets.output: st.download_button for the generated PDF/HTML file

source: Dashboard architecture spec, Section 10.2 Pages 3-6 (conversation-derived, not yet implemented in code)
